name: Romeo-wa Juliet
source:
Save Romeo and Juliet's love from the brink of tragedy!

Romeo and Juliet is a story-based game adapted from the masterpiece drama "Romeo and Juliet" by renowned English playwright William Shakespeare. Experience Romeo and Juliet's forbidden love reborn through a dramatic yet beautiful storyline. This game focuses deeply on the love between Romeo and Juliet. You will witness their first kiss, secret meetings, and wedding, all while confronting the irrational feud of their families.

The completion of the story of "Romeo and Juliet" rests in your hands. At each decisive moment, help the lovers fulfill their romance or escape peril. Making the wrong choice could lead Romeo and Juliet to a tragic fate. Can you, Romeo, and Juliet overcome adversity to create a story of love that surpasses even death?

Encounter diverse choices and explore the thoughts and emotions of Romeo, Juliet, and other characters. Certain choices will lead you along the right path, providing hints to avoid tragedy. The "happy ending" for Romeo and Juliet also depends on you. Gift the trapped lovers a world where they can realize their love

[From [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/romeo-and-juliet-love-story/id6742859534]App Store[/url]]
translation:
将罗密欧与朱丽叶的爱情从悲剧的边缘拯救出来！

《罗密欧与朱丽叶》是一款改编自英国著名剧作家莎士比亚的代表作《罗密欧与朱丽叶》的故事游戏。通过戏剧性而美丽的故事情节体验罗密欧与朱丽叶禁忌之爱的重生。该游戏深刻地聚焦于罗密欧与朱丽叶之间的爱情。你将见证他们的初吻、秘密会面和婚礼，同时面对他们家庭的非理性争斗。

《罗密欧与朱丽叶》故事的完成就掌握在你的手中。在每一个决定性的时刻，帮助有情人完成浪漫或逃离危险。做出错误的选择可能会导致罗密欧和朱丽叶的悲惨命运。罗密欧与朱丽叶，你能克服逆境，创造一个超越死亡的爱情故事吗？

遇到多样化的选择，探索罗密欧、朱丽叶和其他角色的思想和情感。某些选择会引导你走上正确的道路，并提供避免悲剧发生的提示。罗密欧与朱丽叶的“幸福结局”也取决于你。赠予被困恋人一个可以实现爱情的世界

[来自[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/romeo-and-juliet-love-story/id6742859534]App Store[/url]]
